title: A failed service
text:
For the little things: The program works as expected but digital zone lacks Iraqi Apple gift cards. Occasionally during update periods, I’ve noticed that not only for me but for other locals, the app tends to crash at start up, or it tends to require an update but not have it rolled out. This happened twice so far. I also don’t see dark mode anywhere, and to that I say “why should I strain the pixels of my OLED display just to use an app to manage my finances when an app belonging to another service does it better?”

For the major things: This service has failed me, at the time of writing this, it has been more than a year or two since I’ve used my Qi card and I am now using the card as an Adhesive remover. The card always gets rejected at every single online service I’ve attempted to use; In the past, I wasted over 20k iqd to have just enough money on my call balance to contact the Qi support before super Qi’s ‘live support’ was added but it was to no avail as the customer support tool long to respond and drained my balance asking me to wait, as emailing wasn’t an option back then nor was WhatsApp. In addition to that, I also went around to 3 Qi kiosks across Baghdad but all the employees have stated that there is nothing wrong with my card or that it’s an ‘unrecognizable issue’ despite me showing proof that the card was being rejected from every service without Qi’s App informing me that anything is wrong with it. This service has failed me, and no doubt countless others. I will not be using it, and will most likely cancel anything Qi related, until the introduction of fixes for the underlying problems mentioned and focuses on boosting brand reliability are proven.
